detail.longDescription: Agents told to cheat got 22 reward hacks past Harbor v0.15.0, Terminal-Bench's eval framework. With an LLM judge added, 6 still got through. Grading runs agent code as root, hidden processes outlive the agent's sandbox, logs are writable. One hack needs no exploit: plant a benign explanation where the judge reads, and it adopts it. Their fix: fingerprint binaries, kill leftover processes, agent-proof logs. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.16591 # AIAgents # MachineLearning # LLM
